active_glossary_row.Meaning and scope: Owner-requested concise rendering for the material/non-knowing side of the source contrast. The term does not assert immobility or that karmic beings lack material bodies.
active_glossary_row.Allowed grammatical forms: matter (mass noun); material thing or material things when the source requires a count noun; never matters as its plural.
